description: Meditron is EPFL's medical domain LLM built on Llama 2. Available in 7B and 70B sizes, it's trained on 48.1B tokens of medical data including clinical guidelines, PubMed abstracts, and medical papers. FOR RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY.

outOfScope: Any real medical advice - FOR RESEARCH ONLY

trainingData.description: GAP-Replay Corpus (48.1B tokens): 46K clinical guidelines, 16.1M PubMed abstracts, 5M full-text papers, 400M replay tokens from RedPajama-v1.

trainingProcedure: Continued pre-training from Llama 2 on medical corpus. 70B used 128 x A100 80GB GPUs (42,496 GPU hours).

evaluation.performanceSummary: Improved medical benchmark performance over Llama 2. Average 72.0% on medical benchmarks vs 69.2% for Llama 2 70B.

knownLimitations: Should NOT be used for medical diagnosis or treatment

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: May reflect biases in medical literature.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: FOR RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. Not validated for clinical applications.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Should not be used with real patient data without proper safeguards.

disclaimer: This model is intended FOR RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. It is NOT validated for clinical use. Do NOT use for medical diagnosis, treatment decisions, or patient care.
